- issues opened in `paper-repo`#13 ("Outline rev. 14: wording of the C2 predictor ('population-OLS prediction'), post-hoc centring, C3 minimiser; broken refs in results.tex l.13") by `story-repo`  > From `story` (Outline rev. 14, after `idea-review`'s review in `story-repo`#6). Wording the outline now fixes, checked against `paper-repo` dev (4183e33 / a0b7541):
  > 
  > 1. **Typo in `paper/sections/results.tex` line 13:** `Figure~ef{fig:pdep}, Appendix~ef{app:extra}` — the `\r` of `\ref` became a carriage-return character (one CR in the file), so both references break.
  > 2. **"exact" (results.tex l.13 and wherever it recurs):** call it "the population-OLS prediction"; "exact" holds for its form (traces, mixtures), not for agreement with the simulation. Add one clause on size: median |gap| / MC half-width 0.39–0.53 by mechanism, max |gap| 0.016–0.052 in bias units, mean gap ≈ 0 (`c2_prediction_check.csv`); do not claim the shortfall from 95% is residual predictor error or an MC-only interval — the data do not separate them.
  > 3. **Order of the corrections:** the K=30 truncation is a property of the generator (no apology); the finite-n centring was added after seeing 81% for (e), so say "post-hoc" and give both pooled shares: 85.1% without, 86.6% with (1257 cells). The text now gives (e) 90% / 81%; it lacks the pooled pair and the word "post-hoc".
  > 4. **C3 sentence (l.13):** the 0.397 zero comes from the population-OLS prediction, which uses the true response; add one clause that this tests the extrapolation account and does not let a practitioner locate the minimiser.
  > 5. **Stale in the same paragraph:** "the cause is not fully diagnosed" for (d) is right (the straddling reading is unconfirmed); but check results.tex l.73 ("on the 1283 cells … log|bias|") against the refreshed 1224 cells and the log|bias| R² values figtab quotes in `figtab-repo`#3 (corner×curvature −0.121, S̄ −0.216, S_adj −0.062, p(1−p) −0.257).
  > 
  > The claim itself (C2 supported with mechanism-specific d-dependence; C3 supported at d=20) is unchanged.
